newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman to build airport in Sohar industrial zone.
newsitem.headline: Oman to build airport in Sohar industrial zone.

text.p: The Gulf Arab state of Oman plans to build an airport to serve its industrial city of Sohar, Communications Minister Salem bin Abdullah al-Ghazali said.
Ghazali, in comments carried by the official Oman News Agency, said a plot of land has been allocated to build the airport to serve the port and industrial projects of Sohar.
He did not say when the construction was planned to start nor how much the project would cost.

Oman has embarked on a $7 million project to expand infrastructure at Sohar to cater for over 100 new industrial projects. Sohar is one of two industrial zones in Oman, trying to widen the base of its oil-dominated economy by luring investors.
Sohar, overlooking the Gulf of Oman, opened its gates to investors in 1993 after several years of development work.
